commentary: Graded the two system walks over each resolved entry's sweep scope (file plus ripple_cascade.applied) on the committed tree b3fec9f3. The accumulator fix is the one engine change: null-prototype, an own-property check, and an engine test that submits __proto__ / constructor / toString through the write gate and checks keys, total and sum on the written file; the external half's script now prints the expected result. The address-reviews split was checked against the requirement's 'more only where fields cannot appear together' — the three examples differ exactly in provenance fields — and the round trip accepts each in its own scopes. The shared block grammar left no regex reader in either suite; the consumer reference's legacy line reads accurately (other readers still accept findings_summary; this parser reads findings[] only). Old-form sweep (the retired message text, the old example phrasing, the four-scope tag, the regex finder) is empty across src/ and test/. Residual check from b5897ca2 (the commit that added the external return) lists ten files, every one inside a sweep scope. Passes 0 and 6 are whole-change / whole-project and skipped for a verification pass; no lens files exist for 4 and 5.
